summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (after print): joins str(obj) of positional objects with sep, then calls self.print once with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False, passing style, highlight (default True), and end. Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_no_wrap_or_crop, _markup, _emoji, _container, _no_objects, _style, _highlight_default, _highlight_none_uses_console_default, _highlight_false, _render_hook, _returns_none) with new top-level imports RenderHook and Text. Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG Unreleased Added, and a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after Logging. Tests were not run, per instructions; the render-hook and test_out expectations are verified by reading only.
